items.t: Lurches or bucks when braking to a stop
items.job: Diagnose and reprogram hybrid/transmission control software
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs.

items.t: Hybrid warning messages with rough running and low power
items.job: Diagnose hybrid system faults, test 12V battery, update software
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs. Costs rise sharply if hybrid parts must be replaced out of warranty.

items.t: Check engine light with cam timing code P05CE00
items.job: Reprogram engine control computer per bulletin
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs.

items.t: Clicking from front axles when turning and accelerating
items.job: Replace front drive shaft assembly with updated part
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs. Drive shafts are under the 6-year/70,000-mile powertrain warranty.

items.t: Sunroof creaks and dash or headliner rattles
items.job: Noise diagnosis and trim or moonroof rail adjustment
items.note: Normally fixed under warranty. Out of warranty, a noise diagnosis alone runs about $150-225.

items.t: Mark Levinson audio cuts out or lacks bass
items.job: Replace stereo amplifier with updated part
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs.

items.job: Repair fuel door opener per bulletin
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs.

items.t: Touchscreen glitches, stuck day or night mode, or passcode prompts
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs. Some updates install over the air.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy correctly (recall)
items.job: Replace driver and passenger curtain airbags

items.t: Gauge cluster may not show speed or warning lights (recall)
items.job: Instrument panel software update or replacement

items.t: Rearview camera image may not appear (recall)
items.job: Rearview camera software update or camera replacement

items.t: Backup camera can freeze or go blank (recall)
Load capacity label shows the wrong weight (recall)

items.job: Inspect and replace rear axle carriers
Inspect and replace front steering knuckles

items.t: Pulls or drifts to one side
items.job: Check tire pressures, tire placement and wheel alignment
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs. Out of warranty, a four-wheel alignment typically adds about 1-1.5 labor hours.

items.t: Driver floor mat slides out of its clips
items.job: Inspect and repair floor mat retaining clips
items.note: Covered by the Lexus new-vehicle warranty on these SUVs.
A battery test runs about $60-90. A new battery costs more if it fails the test after the warranty.
